meta.title: Divergence - 13
meta.description: When the path ahead is a mystery, how will we know which way we are headed?

units.rawText: The sisters Odile and Odette collapse in a pool of Liquid Entropy. Their pale white faces gaze up at the shattered sky, their eyes reflecting the ruined ceiling.
units.displayText: The sisters Odile and Odette collapse in a pool of Liquid Entropy. Their pale white faces gaze up at the shattered sky, their eyes reflecting the ruined ceiling.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Big... Sis...</color>
units.displayText: Big... Sis...

spans.text: Big... Sis...

units.rawText: Ah... Once again... It's over...
units.displayText: Ah... Once again... It's over...

spans.text: Ah... Once again... It's over...

units.rawText: It seems that this show... has reached its end.
units.displayText: It seems that this show... has reached its end.

units.rawText: Hannah takes all this in with a blank expression.
units.displayText: Hannah takes all this in with a blank expression.

units.rawText: Odile looks toward her and smiles faintly.
units.displayText: Odile looks toward her and smiles faintly.

spans.text: Odile looks toward her and smiles faintly.

units.rawText: I didn't think that a mere agent could evolve to the point where she could take on an entire Tertiary Layer dreamscape...
units.displayText: I didn't think that a mere agent could evolve to the point where she could take on an entire Tertiary Layer dreamscape...

spans.text: I didn't think that a mere agent could evolve to the point where she could take on an entire Tertiary Layer dreamscape...

units.rawText: Could you give me some final audience feedback?
units.displayText: Could you give me some final audience feedback?

spans.text: Could you give me some final audience feedback?

units.rawText: Why did Turing's memory fragment slip from my control... Why were you able to beat us...?
units.displayText: Why did Turing's memory fragment slip from my control... Why were you able to beat us...?

spans.text: Why did Turing's memory fragment slip from my control... Why were you able to beat us...?

units.rawText: ...I still haven't figured out what agents ought to call this.
units.displayText: ...I still haven't figured out what agents ought to call this.

spans.text: ...I still haven't figured out what agents ought to call this.

units.rawText: But in the Professor's words, that would be because of "<color=orange>love</color>".
units.displayText: But in the Professor's words, that would be because of "love".

love

units.rawText: The Turing in my heart loves me best and she doesn't need any reason for it, so she will never be controlled by the Entropy.
units.displayText: The Turing in my heart loves me best and she doesn't need any reason for it, so she will never be controlled by the Entropy.

spans.text: The Turing in my heart loves me best and she doesn't need any reason for it, so she will never be controlled by the Entropy.

units.rawText: And I love her too, so I won't lose myself in matters of art or winning or losing. I simply want to go out and see her.
units.displayText: And I love her too, so I won't lose myself in matters of art or winning or losing. I simply want to go out and see her.

spans.text: And I love her too, so I won't lose myself in matters of art or winning or losing. I simply want to go out and see her.

units.rawText: Love... Is the Turing that waits outside your Tertiary Layer still the same Turing?
units.displayText: Love... Is the Turing that waits outside your Tertiary Layer still the same Turing?

spans.text: Love... Is the Turing that waits outside your Tertiary Layer still the same Turing?

units.rawText: Will she still love you?
units.displayText: Will she still love you?

spans.text: Will she still love you?

units.rawText: As long as one of us retains our memories and continues making new memories, then our love will endure.
units.displayText: As long as one of us retains our memories and continues making new memories, then our love will endure.

spans.text: As long as one of us retains our memories and continues making new memories, then our love will endure.

units.rawText: I believe in her, and so I have absolute faith in myself.
units.displayText: I believe in her, and so I have absolute faith in myself.

spans.text: I believe in her, and so I have absolute faith in myself.

units.rawText: With that, Hannah turns away, walking into the light that grows brighter and brighter. She does not look back.
units.displayText: With that, Hannah turns away, walking into the light that grows brighter and brighter. She does not look back.

spans.text: With that, Hannah turns away, walking into the light that grows brighter and brighter. She does not look back.

units.rawText: You own... choice, is it... I see... Hehe...

spans.text: You own... choice, is it... I see... Hehe...

units.rawText: O bird that flies free, are you the true "protagonist" after all?

units.rawText: Not writing your name... into the cast list in time... was a mistake on my part...
units.displayText: Not writing your name... into the cast list in time... was a mistake on my part...

spans.text: Not writing your name... into the cast list in time... was a mistake on my part...

units.rawText: But things being what they are now... The new generation of actors has taken the stage, and this show... ought to end.
